**C.** The team note states UCC 2-207(2) correctly in general: between merchants, added terms become part of the contract. But it applies only when the response is a definite acceptance that isn't expressly conditional. Costco's confirmation made its acceptance "conditional upon a loading charge," so under 2-207(1) it is a counteroffer. Rainmaking never accepted that charge, so no contract has formed.

CONFIDENCE: 80
